notes.title: 🐾 TO FURR OR NOT TO FURR… THAT IS THE QUESTION!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484784/b348505a88fcf438fda9818ab1bc54c8b2313be4.gif[/img]
Hope you’re enjoying the Spring Sale! Meanwhile, I’m here, trapped in my dev dungeon, working on Early Access and tackling one big hairy decision.

🔥 Right now, in the game, your choices decide if the girls you meet stay human or go full furry.
But here’s the question: Should the MC change too?

When choosing the animalistic path, should the MC:
A) Stay human while the girls transform (human mind, wild experiences)
B) Transform into a furry himself (fully immersive beast mode)

I’m seeing wildly mixed opinions across Reddit and other platforms, so I need to hear it straight from you—the true connoisseurs of juicy transformations.

💬 Drop your thoughts below!

Oh, and by the way, enjoy this small GIF—a sneak peek of our 4-to-human interaction in action.

Before, you only saw a quick tease with the fox, and maybe you noticed… her boobs weren’t exactly dynamic. Well, behold the wolf! 🐺 With her flexi-tits and flexi-ass, she's here to prove that not only do our furries have personality, but also some serious physics.

And yes, the carpet got a little more action than expected. 😏

🐾 Peace, love & woof woof,
JuicyMaiden

notes.title: 👀 >2,000 People Touched My Demo?! 🐾
notes.notes:
🐾 [b]2,000 of You? That’s Like… A Whole Train of Furries?![/b] 🚆
First off, huge thanks to everyone who checked out our demo during NextFest—over 2,000 of you hopped in! That’s more people than I can fit into my tiny dev cave… or like, several buses full of horny visual novel enjoyers. The sheer amount of feedback was overwhelming (in the best way), and I’ve been reading through every comment between bites of instant noodles. Seriously, thank you.
And if I somehow missed your thoughts, drop them in x.com, Discord or write them here—I promise I’ll read them all. 👀
________________________________________

📜 [b]What We Learned (AKA, Size Matters[/b] 🙃)
Here’s the big takeaway:
You want MORE story. More choices. More game.
I get it—we gave you a very brief (some might say too brief) preview. 10 minutes? That’s like… barely enough time to even appreciate the first juicy details. Turns out, [b]Mama told me wrong—size DOES matter.[/b] 😳
So, we’re making some changes:
🔹 Moving Early Access back slightly – We were aiming for the end of March/beginning of April, but to give you a fuller experience, we’re pushing it a bit. Exact date? Depends on our speed, our workflow… and the amount of food we have left.
🔹 Demo is on hold (but coming back better) – The next version will have more playtime, giving you a clearer taste of what’s to come.
________________________________________

🐺[b] A Place for the Wild Ones: NSFW Discord is LIVE![/b]
By popular demand, we’re launching a NSFW 18+ Discord server! That means:
🔥 No restrictions – Talk freely, share content, discuss your wildest VN ideas.
📢 Exclusive sneak peeks – We’ll be dropping content previews and early announcements.
🗳️ Vote for your new doggy alter ego! – Right now, you can help choose the new character! Come bark your opinion. 🐶
Join in, say “woof woof,” and let’s get weird. 🐾 
________________________________________

Thanks again for the support—you’re making this game bigger, better, and wilder than I ever imagined.
🐾 Peace, love, & woof woof,
JuicyMaiden
